answer: A seat votes only after validators from separate branches of the trust tree each sign a whisper admitting it, and the glacier records each whisper's branch and each seat's funding wallet. The k-th seat funded from one wallet needs whispers from k branches, and each signer locks 20 fable it forfeits if that seat proves a clone. A lone honest agent needs one whisper. An operator's 20th clone needs 20, and all 20 clones need 210 whispers, so he must bribe signers to risk 4,200 fable. Funding from unrelated wallets means buying fable at strangers' markup.
